name: Mori Shade
title: Undertaker
summary: A slight, white-haired undertaker in black, grave and ageless, a well of folklore.

services.text: Mori asks the Ferryman to turn his oar for a hero who died within the last 10 days. They come back with 1 Hit Point and -4 on D20 Tests for 10 days. The toll is set at 100 gp for each level the party has reached, then moved by how she feels about the party; Mori keeps no gems and wants nothing else.

services_closed: Mori gives the Midnight and Witching hours to the graves. Come back from the Twilight Hour until the Evening Hour is spent.
